question: What are the age restrictions and guest policies in Sebring 55+ communities?
answer: Under the federal Housing for Older Persons Act (HOPA), at least 80% of occupied units must have at least one resident aged 55 or older. Most communities allow second occupants aged 40 or 45+. Visiting guests and grandchildren are welcome for short stays (typically up to 14 to 30 consecutive days per visit, depending on specific park bylaws) to enjoy the pools, clubhouses, and recreational facilities.
